leaf: a photo of long narrow green rice leaves.

region_view: Preserve every component pixel of the 1120-square resized synthetic RGB image; replace all other pixels with RGB [123,117,104], the rounded CLIP normalization mean. No component bounding-box crop. Apply official CLIP bicubic resize/center-crop to 224 and CLIP normalization.
score: L2-normalize each text embedding, mean the three templates per class, L2-normalize that mean. L2-normalize the CLIP embedding of each component-masked image. Score = cosine(panicle) - max(cosine(leaf), cosine(background)); mean score equally over the fixed 20 source images; select one component by largest mean, ties by lower index.
empty_component: Abort; no zero imputation or skipping.
evaluation: After source assignments are frozen, reaggregate archived per-component target confusion matrices for the identical SHA256-checked GMMs. This is exact evaluation of changed component semantics, not new target feature inference.
inference_precision: float32; DINO cache-compatible float16 token round trip; no autocast, no TF32
scope: Controlled synthetic-source GMM semantic assignment only. Does not establish results for real-source, dual-source or counting models. Fixed before new CLIP inference and target reaggregation.
